profile.headline: Sr. Business Analyst  |  PostgreSQL Developer  |  AI Agent Developer
profile.jobTitle: Sr. Business Analyst | PostgreSQL Developer | AI Agent Builder
profile.summary: Business analyst and developer who builds AI agents and data systems that take manual work off people's plates. 15+ years in financial services (mortgage lending and credit investing), semantics modeling, plus an AI-powered event marketplace I designed, built and run end to end. Turns messy business problems into working software, using agentic workflows with self-improving agents. Self-directed and quick to build trust with clients, stakeholders and technical teams.

positions.title: Sr. Business Analyst | PostgreSQL Developer | AI Agent Builder
positions.description:
•  Built data platforms that help private and public credit investment teams track and analyze their loan portfolios (AWS including Step Functions, Python, C#, AngularJS, PostgreSQL), including a formula builder that lets clients design their own dashboards with geospatial mappings.

•  Created Mossy, an AI assistant that answers back-office support questions for the firm's investment platform: 80+ skills, ~50 database and scripting tools, automated quality checks, and a nightly process that turns analysts' corrections into permanent improvements. Wrote 187 of its 191 code changes in two months.

•  Rebuilt the monitoring for ~570 daily client data feeds: an automated classifier sorts every failure by its cause and writes the fix, so real problems are no longer buried under false alarms.

•  Cut one client's failing data feeds from 77% (193 of 251) to 2% (6 of 251) by tuning when each feed is expected to arrive, then standardized the setting across both environments.

•  Traced the biggest source of false alerts (162 feeds) to two bugs in the alerting code and gave engineering the evidence to fix them.

•  Solved client-facing data mismatches (missing trustee values, cash breaks on newly closed loan deals, stale vendor prices) by tracing each to its source, and turned undocumented data flows into step-by-step runbooks.
positions.insights: Skills: PostgreSQL · C# · AngularJS · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Cloud Computing · AWS Lambda · Bedrock · Deterministic LLM Programming

positions.title: Full-Stack Developer | AI Agent Builder
positions.description:
•  Designed, built and run an online marketplace where clients find and book DJs, photographers, bartenders and other event pros, and pros run their business in one place: leads, instant quotes, e-signed contracts, Stripe payments, scheduling and automatic reminders (Python, PostgreSQL, AWS EC2, RDS, S3, SES).

•  Built Nimbus, an AI assistant (Claude on AWS Bedrock) that answers client questions, checks availability, prepares quotes and bookings with the user's confirmation, and can fill in forms on the site for them, with security safeguards against misuse.

•  Created an AI development team of 10 specialized agents (planning, coding, database, QA, design, research, marketing) that plans a 2,500+ item backlog and close them in a single day, writes and reviews code, and ships small safe changes on its own, with automated quality checks and a daily spending cap that cut its AI cost by 60%.

•  Design agents to monitor competitors and automate backlogs for the latest features and oversea tasks to completion.

•  Turned client questionnaires into AI-written event timelines and MC scripts, and automated marketing: a weekly AI-written newsletter for pros, campaign tracking from first click to booking, and a control-group test that measures real booking lift.

•  Keep it reliable on my own: automatic deployments with pre-release checks, and a monitor that restarts failed services and notification when something breaks.

•  Built an AI-driven social media campaign workflow: research agents analyze competitor content, and the Meta APIs plan and schedule the posts. Used Stability AI to generate campaign images that build on what works for competitors, with brand-specific improvements.  Automated campaign research, creative and scheduling, cutting manual prep time by 95%.

positions.title: Sr. Business Analyst
positions.description:
•  Analyzed and interpreted data, develops alternatives, presents findings and recommendations. Act as a consultant to corporate decision makers and assists in the improvement of departmental operations.

•  Analyzed and gathered stakeholder’s requirements and processes through document analysis, SME interviews, workshops and workflow analysis.

•  Administered TrackVia CRM System roles, services, and application development. Established automated server generation recipe,  integrated critical business processes and communication for internal/external business partners, developed operational dashboards, enhanced current/new workflows, and streamlined business functions.

•  Developed Case Management system and reporting tools: organize fraud investigations, case link abilities, task assignment, and system integration. Incorporate machine learning to detect potential fraud related cases.

•  Experience in scripting, ETL system integration, and application development. Proficient in various programing languages: C++, C#, SQL, Groovy, Java, JavaScript, Python, VB, and more.

•  Developed sophisticated Power BI scorecards with drill-down and drill-through dashboards including key metrics into business functions, business partners, and vendors. Produced innovative data visualization for risk and forecasting models.

•  Daily duties include but are not limited to data retrieval and Ad-Hoc reports. Development, customization, automation of reports. Maintenance of Data Warehouse integration. Consistently, enhance and improve IDE and CRM business systems. Implementation of proposals to enhance operational effectiveness, cost control, real-time analysis, and system integration.

•  Facilitated and coordinated technical projects by acting as the liaison between the business stakeholders, developers, and offshore technology groups.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL Server Analysis Services (SSAS) · Data Modeling · Visual Basic .NET (VB.NET) · Microsoft SQL Server
